map.name: Kell Varn
map.setting: a frozen fort on a mountain pass
map.trouble: The Ogre Warlord Zhurg holds the mine hold above the pass and has taken the Staff of Thaw.

guard_bark.specifics: Brek, guard at the Pass Gate of Kell Varn

first.speaker: Brek
first.text: Warden Odrin is waiting in the Long Hall. He has the key to the Pass Gate.

again.speaker: Brek
again.text: You've got the wrong guard, sorry.

later.speaker: Brek
later.text: Did you see where the Captain went? He wouldn't have left without a word!

bounty_offer.specifics: Orlo, a trapper, asks the player to learn what became of his brother in the White Wolves' den

offer.speaker: Orlo
offer.text:
Mangy brutes! The White Wolves have come down off the heights and made a terror of the whole pass!

I am Master Trapper Orlo. I am looking for my brother. I fear he has strayed into a nearby Wolf Den.

If you could find out what happened and bring me word, I would be willing to teach you the trade. Come with me and I will point out the cursed Wolf Den above his cabin.

reminder.speaker: Orlo
reminder.text: Any sign of my brother? Oh no, I fear he is gone.

completion.speaker: Orlo
completion.text:
My brother's cap! Bad luck must have caught up with him.

You have shown the wolves could not stop you. Maybe you would make a fine trapper. Hmmm... Yes.

Follow me to the cabin. Whenever you like, take the Bow off the rack. We have plenty of trapping ahead of us up there.

journal.text: Learn the fate of Orlo's brother.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Mylka, who keeps the magic shop, lost her Amulet of Warmth to the Imps

offer.speaker: Mylka
offer.text:
Wretched little fiends! The Imps have crept into my cellar and made a mess of everything already!

I am Mylka. I am looking for my Amulet of Warmth. I fear it has been carried off to a nearby Imp Nest.

If you could get it back from them, I would be willing to teach you a spell or two. Will you search the wretched Imp Nest for it?

refusal.speaker: Mylka
refusal.text: Oh. Well, come back if you change your mind.

reminder.speaker: Mylka
reminder.text: Have you got my amulet back yet? Oh my, I feel so cold.

completion.speaker: Mylka
completion.text:
My Amulet of Warmth! I feared it was lost for good.

You are braver than you look. Perhaps you might make a fine student.

Follow me to the counter. Please take this Blue Potion with my thanks. We have much to discuss when you return from your quest.

after.speaker: Mylka
after.text: Whenever you are free, step up to my counter and we will begin.

journal.text: Recover Mylka's Amulet of Warmth from the Imp Nest.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Mylka's Amulet of Warmth from the Imp Nest.

rumour.specifics: three townsfolk of Kell Varn: Ogres at the pass, the Warden, a spy

rumour1.speaker: Hobb
rumour1.text: Kell Varn will never fall to the Ogres. Stand firm for the honor of Warden Odrin!

rumour2.speaker: Vessa
rumour2.text: No, we dare not sleep while the Ogres hold the pass!

rumour3.speaker: Ketra
rumour3.text: A spy from the Hold just ran past me! Be fast! He's heading for the gate!

shop_greeting.specifics: Brisa the innkeeper, Dagg the smith, Mylka of the magic shop

inn.speaker: Brisa
inn.text: Hope you don't need a room any time soon, lad. You seem to have plenty left to do.

arms.speaker: Dagg
arms.text:
Wanna see a new blade?

I call it 'Ogre's Lullaby.'

magic.speaker: Mylka
magic.text: So, you carry both the Staff of Thaw and the Warden's Key. Well done, brave Adventurer!

two_givers.specifics: Tam wants his goat Gruff back from the Ogres of Hald Rock raid; Pell, a smuggler's runner, lost his boss's crate to the Urchins

offer_a.speaker: Tam
offer_a.text:
Sir! Help me please! A mob of foul Ogres just raided Hald Rock, the camp north of here and carried off almost all of the goats! One of them is my favorite billy, Gruff!

Please bring him back and I promise you a reward!

offer_b.speaker: Pell
offer_b.text:
The Urchins just made off with my boss's precious crate! If I come back without it, he'll skin me. He's due any minute!

Please, kind sir, you have to help me! I think the Urchins went toward the lower gate.

Could you... would you fetch it for us?

outcome_a.speaker: Tam
outcome_a.text: Thank you so much, kind stranger! Take these as tokens of my appreciation!

outcome_b.speaker: Pell
outcome_b.text: Oh, thank goodness! Please take this as a token of our appreciation!

journal_a.text: Rescue Tam's goat Gruff from the Ogre pens.

journal_b.text: Get Pell's crate back from the Urchins by the lower gate.

rescue.specifics: The Captain begs the player to free Tolly and the drovers of Hald Rock from the Ogres of Zhurg's Hold

plea.speaker: Captain
plea.text: Hurry, lad! The drovers don't have much time. You must rescue all of them before the Ogres roast them!

following.speaker: Tolly
following.text: We thought no one would come!

completion.speaker: Captain
completion.text:
Good work, my son! All these hardy drovers owe you their lives!

Now go find the other drovers!

journal.text: Rescue Tolly and the drovers of Hald Rock held captive in Zhurg's Hold.

main_opening.specifics: Warden Odrin sends the player through the old mine tunnel into Zhurg's Hold after the Staff of Thaw

herald.speaker: Wenk
herald.text: Warden Odrin wants to see you -- that's a bad sign.

opening.speaker: Warden Odrin
opening.text:
Sorry about the cold, lad, but the old mine tunnel is the quietest way into Zhurg's Hold. Two Ogre sentries watch the entrance, and plenty more patrol inside.

You must bring back the Staff of Thaw, but Zhurg will not part with it willingly. This may turn nasty. But these scrolls will help.

reminder.speaker: Warden Odrin
reminder.text: Haste will be invaluable for slipping past the sentries. The Shield spell will help turn aside their clubs on your way back. Good luck and good speed.

journal.text: Sneak into Zhurg's Hold through the mine tunnel.
